purpose: Reconstruct the Project-Frankenstein -> EntityOS/HCU workspace/GWT lineage without inflating historical broadcast primitives, current component source, or external GWT/GNWT literature into full current runtime evidence.
evidence_law: external GNWT/GWT evidence != Project-Frankenstein runtime evidence

lineage.engineering_role: Pre-workspace admission/relevance control: determine which state competes for scarce cognitive access.
negative_evidence: missing is_entity_active field previously killed a path with TypeError
documented entity_session mode previously lacked a profile
gain/selection plumbing cannot be credited unless selected state measurably reaches downstream cognition
lineage.boundary: Historical channel/gain logic is not proof of current GWT competition, broadcast or uptake.

lineage.negative_evidence: The indexed source does not itself establish coalition competition/selection, receiver causal uptake, downstream behavior change, verified outcome, or re-entry closure.
lineage.boundary: A message bus is necessary/useful plumbing in some designs but is not sufficient evidence for a global-workspace causal mechanism.

lineage.engineering_role: Persistent multi-timescale control around bounded model-facing cognition.
lineage.negative_evidence: Historical operation showed that a larger process could remain alive while a producer/workspace cognitive path disappeared, so global process uptime is not evidence that the intended workspace pathway is healthy.

lineage.observed_current_claim: Exact-merge singleton repair exists at component source/test scope; physical-grid Hyperposition/GWT re-entry remains blocked pending physical-grid runtime acceptance.
counterhypotheses: broadcast content is present but not causally used
majority/recurrence merely amplifies a shared error
logging correlation is mistaken for causal transfer
lineage.boundary: No full HCU, physical-grid or Global J-Space runtime credit.

lineage.target: VARIABLE COGNITIVE GRID + PERSISTENT DATABASE + CLAUDE CODE with a shared global-workspace/J-Space bridge.
lineage.interface_law: Use the strongest actually exposed Claude Code interface. Typed packets, structured state, compressed summaries or vectors may be used where supported; activation-level access cannot be claimed without direct interface evidence.

lineage.hypothesis: Transferred workspace/J-Space state can be shown to alter later cognition on both the variable-grid side and the strongest actually exposed Claude Code interface.
lineage.serious_counterhypothesis: The useful effect is entirely explainable by ordinary structured prompt/context transfer; a deeper shared representational space adds no measurable causal advantage.
lineage.falsifier: Under matched task/model/tool/token budgets, truthful transferred state fails to outperform lesion/shuffled transfer or fails to produce a receiver-specific causal-use trace and downstream outcome difference.

external_primary_context.source: Cogitate Consortium et al., Nature 642, 133-142 (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-08888-1
external_primary_context.project_transfer: Use adversarial/preregistered divergent predictions and explicit pass/fail interpretations where feasible.
external_primary_context.non_transfer: The neuroscience result neither proves nor disproves the project's engineering workspace, Global J-Space, cognition or consciousness claims.

current_acceptance_shape.credit_boundary: A successful component or one side of the bridge does not establish full Global J-Space or whole EntityOS/HCU runtime acceptance.

open_gaps: This file is grounded partial history, not exhaustive commit-by-commit archaeology of every workspace generation.
Exact first-introduction commits for each historical workspace submechanism remain to be reconstructed from the frozen Project-Frankenstein Git history.
Current physical variable-grid competition/broadcast/uptake/re-entry has not been promoted by this curation pass.
